name: Quest Keys At Traders
description_html:
I play SPT without flea and I find it almost impossible to find most of the keys.

I don’t like using mods that will make keys spawn randomly as I endup with too many keys and I want somewhat of a challenge

Solution: Traders have to sell some keys!

Please let me know if I missed any keys.

This mod should work on SPT 3.8 and up to 3.11.4 (If you are on a version earlier than .11, just update the SPT version in package.json).
